summaries.n-gta6-dacity-coin: Coins named for Dacity Coin, an in-game meme coin that posts say appears in GTA 6 material. On 2026-10-11 the account @robtmb1 (RobTheMaster) posted that there is a meme coin in GTA 6 called "Dacity Coin" in a new leak; the first Dacity Coin on pump.fun was created 35 seconds later (token created 2026-10-11 11:16 UTC, post at 11:15 UTC). A post of 2026-10-19 from the GTA 6 Intel account says DacityCoin appears on a stunt plane in GTA VI's launch trailer, a fictional crypto brand parodying real meme coins. An automated claim check rated the claim "partly real" on 2026-10-18, saying the Dacity Coin name in GTA 6 material is real and widely reported but the leak timestamp and the leak's authenticity were not verified. Posts of 2026-10-24 (e1:6) repeat the claim in new words: one account says a clip shows a "CoinSide" trading app and that a plane with Dacity Coin branding appears in the launch trailer, another calls the coin an overhyped side-mission stunt promotion, and a third promotes a $GDC coin; none is an official source. Four coins carry the name: Dacity Coin (pump.fun, Solana; token created 2026-10-11 11:16 UTC), DacityCoin (pump.fun; token created 2026-10-15 13:18 UTC; added today on its name), AudaCity (pump.fun, symbol DacityCoin; token created 2026-10-15 13:22 UTC) and Dacity Coin (Pons, Robinhood Chain; created 2026-10-19 16:13 UTC). Their metadata is empty, so their names carry the claim. Most posts about the coins are call-group promotion and listing-vote spam, and none of the coins is shown to be affiliated with Rockstar, Take-Two or the leak. These are traders' and the coins' own claims. Measured: four coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-perpetual-futures: Coins whose metadata describes perpetual-futures trading. Papertrade's site (papertrade.xyz, e1:0) says "1000x leverage, 0 market impact, 100% user owned, fully onchain on hyperliquid". Posts of 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-20 say PAPER traded as a pre-launch perpetual on Hyperliquid through Paragon and that the market was halted and settled after Papertrade said PAPER would not be transferable (e1:4, one post, not verified here); the newest $PAPER post (2026-10-24 13:13 UTC, e1:4) is a promotional summary of the PAPER ICO, not from Papertrade. Paper coins copying Papertrade's tagline come from Clanker and change from day to day: a new Base contract (0xbec0c6..., pool created 2026-10-24 07:33 UTC, token created 07:25 UTC) joined today on the same tagline, the Robinhood Chain contract from 2026-10-23 (0x179b22...) stays, and the Base contract from 2026-10-21 (0xd0814c...) left on 2026-10-24 because its 24h pool volume stayed under $1,000 on two consecutive observations (membership stays open). No post names any of these contracts, so their affiliation with Papertrade is not verified. Virtual Trade (VIRTUAL, pump.fun) describes itself as a perpetual trading protocol for memecoins with up to 1000x, and FloatSheets (FLOAT, Pons, Robinhood Chain) as a synthetic equity perps platform. EmpireX (EMPIREX, Pons, Robinhood Chain) says it is a perpetual trading hub powered by Hyperliquid. Purps (PURPS, Meteora DBC) says it launches perp-backed tokens. Aloooong (pump.fun) calls itself the "First 10x PUMP long perpetual meme". These are the projects' and traders' own claims: revenue, leverage, payouts and affiliation among the coins are not verified. Measured: the coins named above across all their pools.
